title: Grace Allowed Past the Guaranteed Period on a Retrofit Project
content:
# Grace Allowed Past the Guaranteed Period

An owner of a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects who has taken the closeout in hand is allowed a few days past the end of the guaranteed period before damages begin.

**Where the punch list was cleared on or before the day it fell due and a confirmed closeout acceptance stands on the project record, 5 days of grace are allowed past the end of the guaranteed period before damages begin.**

**Where the punch list was cleared on or before the day it fell due and no confirmed closeout acceptance stands on the project record, 2 days of grace are allowed.**

**Where the punch list was not cleared on or before the day it fell due, no grace is allowed, that is 0 days.**

## How the punch list is read

The day the punch list was cleared is the day of the most recent owner walkthrough inspection passed on the project. Where no owner walkthrough stands on the project at all, the punch list has not been cleared on or before the day it fell due and no grace is allowed. Clearing on the due day itself counts as on or before it.

| Owner walkthrough passed on or before the punch list due day | Confirmed closeout acceptance on the record | Grace allowed |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 5 days |
| yes | no | 2 days |
| no, or none recorded | yes | none |
| no, or none recorded | no | none |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Punch list due the 20th, owner walkthrough passed the 18th, a confirmed closeout acceptance on the record: 5 days of grace.
- Punch list due the 20th, owner walkthrough passed the 20th, no closeout acceptance: 2 days of grace.
- Punch list due the 20th, owner walkthrough passed the 23rd: no grace, whatever the closeout acceptance shows.
